text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Christmas night. The faint sound of wind 
can be heard from outside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...The sound of wind through the pines. 
This, too, is a classic sign of winter.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even a chilly wintry wind can feel 
refreshing. Would you like to step 
outside?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks a little chilly, but... Yamanin 
Zephyr went out of her way to invite me.
choice_data_list: Got it, shall we go then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My breath was pure white. It really clears 
your head...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"This northern wind... haaah... It truly 
feels like it's piercing right through the 
skin."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The winter desolation has spread all 
around here too... It wouldn't be 
surprising if it turned into a blizzard at 
any moment.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, can you hear that, Trainer? An 
unseasonal banquet breeze... It's echoing 
all the way over here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps that is the sound of 
Kururin-san carrying a favorable wind."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"He must be flying across the night sky in 
his sleigh, all for the sake of the 
children."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Still, this cold seems like it will take a 
toll... Let us at least pray for a calm 
winter day.
choice_data_list:
Reindeer are resistant to the cold, so 
they'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Kururin-san is fluffy— 
and quite strong and robust, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I am certain she will overcome even the 
sharpest, most biting headwind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I wish to learn from her as well. Not 
merely shrinking from the fierce mountain 
winds, but running boldly—such is the 
strength of Kururin-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strength to conquer headwinds. To help 
her gain that, as her Trainer, I will 
support... port—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! Could it be a cold...?
choice_data_list:
I just got a little cold, so I'm totally 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Hehe. Is even the storm a fond 
memory to you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then, may you grow healthier, so you can 
make it to better days—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr pulled out a scarf. Its 
festive Christmas colors looked striking 
against the night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One wrap around my neck... then two... She 
wound it carefully, tucking away any gaps. 
Through the scarf, I could feel her warmth 
and care.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's winter wind-blown snow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If anything, though... hehe. You look just 
like Kururin-san... hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Look, your scarf is bundled up so nicely 
at your chest. Ehehe... it suits you well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...That scarf is a breeze of good news 
from me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The frosty wind is harsh. Yet, it is also 
the path that leads to the blessed 
breeze."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please, use it to accompany you through 
the rough winds. If it wouldn't be a 
bother...
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's so warm, I can't take it off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze... is it? I'm so glad to 
hear that...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it was supposed to be a wintry gale. 
Yet looking back, it was so peaceful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I was just... lingering a bit in 
the night breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps it's time... to calm down. 
Before I turn into a sickle-weasel."
choice_data_list: Let's go catch the breeze again somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Tomorrow, I'll go wherever the 
wind takes me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, have a wonderful Christmas. 
Good night.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*. The pleasant night breeze—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: *Achoo*...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um... pardon me. It seems the gust of wind 
is causing mischief.
choice_data_list: Shall we buy a scarf for you too?
Let's buy a scarf for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, are you quite sure? To offer such 
an auspicious breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Then, I shall take you up on that 
offer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The city was bustling, and the shops were 
packed. Come to think of it, Yamanin 
Zephyr was never fond of crowds.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, I'll go buy it for you

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A gentle, triumphant south wind, as 
always... That's so like you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However... the breeze following the calm 
has begun to caress my cheek.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I want to overcome this tempest. Together 
with you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr steps up right beside me, 
close enough for our shoulders to brush. 
Matching her pace so we wouldn't get 
separated, I walked toward the shop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing our way through the crowd, we 
moved forward. When we finally reached our 
destination, we spent time picking out a 
muffler together.
